---
name: speckit.constitution
description: Create or review the project constitution and non-negotiable quality principles
---
Establish or review the constitution for the project:
1. Define modular architecture and separation of concerns.
2. Define coding style, dependencies policy, and error handling conventions.
3. State security rules (zero secrets in code, input sanitization).
4. Establish measurable quality gates and testing requirements.
Save the output to `specs/smart-task-api/constitution.md`.
